# Octopart API
> GraphQL API for electronic component supply data from Octopart (parts, offers, part families, reference designs, solution templates, software projects and BOM analysis), organised into bounded contexts.

How to navigate (for assistants):
1. Pick the bounded context for the task (list below).
2. Read that context's llms.txt: entities, entry points, operations.
3. Load its schema.graphql slice instead of the full schema.
Conventions: one endpoint, `https://api.nexar.com/graphql`; auth is a Bearer token from the OAuth 2.0 client credentials grant (see Developer Center); operation and type names carry a domain prefix (`sup` supply, `dat` data products, then the area: `supPartFamily`, `supRefDesign`, `supSolutionTemplate`, `supEvalKit`, `supSoftwareProject`, `datBom`); most mutations take `input: XInput!` and return `XPayload!` with a typed `errors` union; search and list operations page by offset (`start`/`limit`, total in `hits`), and the `…Search` operations of solution templates, evaluation kits and software projects are Relay connections (`first`/`after`); some fields need a plan tier or plan feature, noted in their description.

## Bounded contexts
- [Supply](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/supply/llms.txt): Parts, offers, sellers, manufacturers, categories, attributes, part search and part matching.
- [Part Family](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/part-family/llms.txt): Part families and part groups, their parameters, and search across families and their parts.
- [Reference Design](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/reference-design/llms.txt): Reference designs, their files, parts, evaluation kits and resources.
- [Solution Template](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/solution-template/llms.txt): Solution templates, reusable blueprints for an integrated hardware and software solution, and their applications, parameters, compatible evaluation kits and reference designs.
- [Eval Kit](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/eval-kit/llms.txt): Evaluation kits, their devices, parameters, preview images, and the reference designs and software projects they are compatible with.
- [Supply Software Project](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/supply-software-project/llms.txt): Software projects for solution templates, evaluation kits and reference designs, with their parameters and compatibility.
- [Procurement](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/procurement/llms.txt): Bill of materials analysis built on supply data: part matching for BOM lines, part history, duplicate and category analysis.

## Guides
- [Getting started](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/guides/getting-started.md): The endpoint, the Authorization header, a first part search, and the Nitro and Voyager tools.
- [Bounded contexts](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/guides/bounded-contexts.md): The seven bounded contexts of the Octopart API, what each one owns, and what the gateway serves that this site does not document.
- [Naming conventions](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/guides/naming-conventions.md): Domain prefixes, lookup and search operation names, Set and Patch mutations, and the Input, Payload and Error types.
- [Pagination](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/guides/pagination.md): Offset paging with start, limit and hits, and cursor paging with first, after and pageInfo.
- [Errors](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/guides/errors.md): The errors array and partial data, and the typed errors in mutation payloads.
- [Plans and limits](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/guides/plans-and-limits.md): What the plan tier, plan feature and constraint notes in field and argument descriptions mean.

## Optional
- [Common types](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/common/llms.txt): Shared scalars, paging, errors and sorting types used across all bounded contexts.
- [Deprecated](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/deprecated/llms.txt): deprecated operations by bounded context
- [Full schema SDL](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/schema.graphql): ~40333 tokens — prefer per-context slices
- [llms-full.txt](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/llms-full.txt): all guides and reference pages as markdown (~213255 tokens)
